run_gtest_test_utils: run the googletest test utilities module to parse flags and execute unit tests
test_Subprocess_class: test the Subprocess class to execute commands and capture stdout and stderr output
create_temp_directory: create a temporary directory for test files using GetTempDir that auto cleans on exit
get_test_executable_path: get the absolute path of a test binary given its name and build directory
parse_gtest_flags: parse and strip Google Test flags from command line arguments using _ParseAndStripGTestFlags
